about: The body plans the creature maker knows. status: rigged = the prep step builds a rig and clips; static = a model with no rig. prep is the mode the Blender prep step runs in (serpentine or static). make lists the steps a plan allows. min_elongation (serpentine only): the least the body may be long, over its width or height, measured on the picture's shape before the fit; a coil is about 1 and is refused. ground (true for a body that stands on legs): the pack refuses a body that stands taller than it is long. facing_after_prep: the axis the game model's head points along once the prep has run; the pack states it as its forward axis (+Z for every plan: the Blender prep turns the head to -Y, which glTF exports as +Z).

serpentine.label: Serpentine
serpentine.note: Rigged: one bone per body segment, five clips. The eel pilot is this plan. Its up direction has no picture check yet: the picture check is for static bodies, and it can not read a rigged model (2026-10-17). Not proven: no serpent made here is proven, and the Brine-elder's spines lie along its lower edge.

quadruped.label: Quadruped
quadruped.note: Built as a static model: its rig is not built yet. Made in 3D again from 2026-10-17 (the owner's decision). Its up direction is confirmed by its picture (the Road-hound: 0.63 against 0.35), and its proportion check passes (final height 0.72 of its length). Not proven (2026-10-17): its belly and near front leg tear into spurs, which fails the surface rule of the proof rubric.

six-leg.label: Six-legged
six-leg.note: Built as a static model: its rig is not built yet. Proven 2026-10-17 on one creature (the Sand-crab): it stands upright, its six legs are under the body and nothing stray is in the model. Its shape is squatter than the picture.

flying.label: Flying
flying.note: Built as a static model: its rig is not built yet. Not proven (2026-10-17): the Far-country hawk stands upright and its picture check confirms it, but at 20,000 triangles its wings and tail shred into stair-stepped slabs with floating fragments. Its brief has no perch now (in mid-air).
